research_notes: Identify early teaching schools/payrolls, music clients, sewing and image-consulting entities, individual hours and leave. Resolve duplicate music descriptions and concurrent work/study; obtain Zoe appointment/pay evidence and exact executive departure.

2026-09-29 initial research used APH indexed official chronology, member biography and maiden speech, Zoe Support 2019 annual report and local pupil alumni story. Zoe 2018 report timed out; LinkedIn returned no readable content. No access restrictions bypassed.

Targeted school/music/seamstress/full-time searches found multiple overseas and Australian namesakes; their employment histories were not imported. Red Cliffs Secondary College is a pupil's school in the source, not a verified employing school for Webster.

Zoe annual report documents stepping down, successor arrangements and patron role but not individual hours/pay. Its 2012 service commencement differs from APH's 2011 founder period; both retained without altering dates to produce a total. Board experience is mentioned but complete organisation-level governance chronology remains a lead.

Secondary reporting identifies Mallee Accommodation and Support Program board service from 2005 and chair tenure; targeted employer-domain search did not retrieve a confirming primary record. Follow historical MASP reports. Social-worker label may describe Zoe work and must not become an invented additional employer spell.

Known overlapping year ranges cannot be added. Missing employer control and hours remain unknown, not public/private zero. Last follow-up 2026-09-29; blocked record requires later systematic evidence follow-up.
